# Contributor agreement

By opening a pull request against this repository, you agree to the terms below.
There is nothing to sign and no form to fill in. Opening the pull request is the
agreement.

Last updated September 26, 2026. **Not reviewed by a lawyer.**

## You keep your copyright, and you license it to everyone

You retain copyright in what you contribute. You grant Fusion Development Group
and every recipient of this project a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive,
royalty-free, irrevocable license to use, reproduce, modify, distribute, and
sublicense your contribution under the MIT license in the repository root.

**You license your contribution. You do not assign it.** An assignment would
take ownership away from you. We hold every product to one test: what happens
to its users if Fusion disappears. Keeping your copyright means you can carry
your work on without us. The license is all the project needs to ship.

**We do not relicense your contribution.** Fusion will not ship your
contribution under terms more restrictive than MIT. If the project's license
ever changes, the change applies only to new work, and anything you contributed
under MIT stays available under MIT.

## You have the right to contribute it

You confirm that the contribution is your own work, or that you have the right to
submit it under this agreement, and that it does not knowingly infringe anyone
else's rights. If your employer has rights in work you do, you confirm that you
have permission or that the employer waives those rights.

If any part of a contribution is not yours, say so in the pull request, and name
its origin and its license. Third-party code under a license nobody named is
hard to remove later.

## Patents

You grant a patent license on the same terms: perpetual, worldwide,
non-exclusive, royalty-free, and irrevocable, covering claims you own that are
necessarily infringed by your contribution as part of this project. If you
initiate patent litigation alleging that this project infringes, the licenses

## No warranty, and no obligation on either side

You provide contributions as is, without warranty. We are under no obligation to
merge, keep, or continue to ship any contribution, and we may remove or rewrite
it. Contributing creates no employment, partnership, or agency relationship, and
no entitlement to compensation.

## AI-assisted contributions

We welcome contributions written with a coding assistant and hold them to the
same standard as any other. You are the contributor, and the confirmations above
are yours to make. A model writing the code does not transfer those
confirmations to anyone else. If a tool reproduced code that it did not author,
treat it as third-party code, as described above, and name it.

## Questions

Send questions about this agreement to the address in
